name: Royal Hotel Sanremo
insider_take: This Belle Époque palace has been the crown jewel of the Italian Riviera since 1872, where Russian royalty once wintered and modern luxury meets timeless elegance.
whats_special: The Royal Hotel sits majestically above Sanremo's famous Casino, offering panoramic views of the Mediterranean. Its subtropical gardens span 16,000 square meters and feature rare plants that thrive in the unique microclimate. The hotel's Michelin-starred Il Fiore restaurant serves innovative Ligurian cuisine, while the rooftop pool provides an infinity experience overlooking the azure coastline.
pro_tip: Book a sea-view suite during the Sanremo Music Festival (February) for front-row seats to Italy's most prestigious musical event, with many performers staying at the hotel.
dont_miss: Stroll through the historic La Pigna old town with its medieval labyrinth of stairs and archways, just minutes away. Visit the nearby French border at Menton (20 minutes) for duty-free shopping, or take the scenic coastal drive to Monaco's Monte Carlo (45 minutes) along one of Europe's most beautiful coastlines.
pros: Iconic Belle Époque architecture set within lush private gardens overlooking the Italian Riviera
Stunning heated seawater pool and private beach club offering direct Mediterranean access
Refined Italian dining with panoramic sea views at the acclaimed La Terrazza restaurant
Luxurious spa and wellness facilities featuring a full range of beauty and relaxation treatments
Prime location steps from Sanremo's vibrant casino, boutiques, and cultural attractions
cons: Historic property may appeal less to guests seeking contemporary, minimalist design aesthetics
Beach access requires a short walk down terraced gardens, which may not suit all mobility levels
